title: Foundation Mastery Check I
objective: Determine whether quantity, cardinality, conservation, and comparison are secure enough to move into Unit 0.2's part/whole work.

tasks.prompt: Count a group of 7-9 objects correctly, twice, in different orders.
Predict, then confirm, that a group's count is unchanged after rearranging it, explaining how you know it's still the same amount.
Use pairing (not counting) to correctly compare two groups and justify the comparison.

mastery.passEvidence: All three tasks completed correctly, with a verbal justification for the rearrangement task that references "nothing was added or removed," not just "it looks the same."
mastery.reteachTrigger: Miscounts the same group twice in different orders (reteach 0.1.1) or believes rearrangement changes the count even after a demonstration (reteach 0.1.3 with more examples).
